advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Consider skipping in-place self-heal on a source-advancing tick when an mcp_delta is pending (the blue-green deploy will replace the backend anyway) to avoid a wasted health-wait and a spurious mcp-live-backend-down alarm.
evidence: infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:993: log "main advanced $DEPLOYED -> $TARGET; computing component deltas"
infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:934: err mcp-live-backend-down "live mcp backend $name on port $live is NOT running; /mcp is failing"
infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:1192: if ! mcp_backoff_active && mcp_delta; then  (blue-green replacement runs after self-heal)
advisory.finding: On a source-advancing tick, mcp_self_heal_live_backend runs (line 994) before the blue-green deploy decision, so when an MCP source change is pending AND the live backend is dead, the watchdog performs a full docker start + up-to-MCP_HEALTH_TIMEOUT health wait on a container the subsequent blue-green deploy immediately replaces/retires, and emits an AUTODEPLOY_ERROR mcp-live-backend-down right before a routine deploy — wasting a health-timeout cycle and raising a spurious deploy-error alarm.
scenarios: origin/main advances with an mcp path change while the live MCP container is already dead: the watchdog restarts+health-waits it, alarms mcp-live-backend-down, then the deploy discards it.

coverage.approach_viability_note: 0 surviving high-priority finding(s), Pass-2 drop-rate 50% — the approach (not just nits) may be worth a second look (advisory; the verdict is unchanged).

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Add self-heal health-failure tests that seed health-8092 with a store-expected-but-missing body and a handshake ok=false body, asserting the restart is treated as failed (rc!=0, mcp-deploy-backoff recorded).
evidence: autodeploy.sh:891 `[ "$store" = "missing" ] && return 1` and autodeploy.sh:898 `[ "$handshake" = "failed" ] && return 1` are added lines in the new mcp_health_contract_ok

test_dead_live_mcp_backend_health_failure_is_retryable seeds only `(mcp_box["dstate"] / "health-8092").write_text("DOWN")`, which the curl stub (line 147 `case "$body" in ""|DOWN) exit 22`) turns into a curl failure hitting the `|| return 1` branch, not the store-missing or handshake-failed branches

Named violating inputs not covered by any self-heal test: a restart whose /health returns `{"in_flight":0,"store":{"present":false,"expected":true}}` (store-missing branch) or `{"in_flight":0,"handshake":{"ok":false}}` (handshake-failed branch)
The pre-existing store/handshake tests (lines 696-803, 2495+) exercise the deploy-path promotion gate, a separate call site, not the new mcp_health_contract_ok used by mcp_wait_health_contract
dropped.finding: The newly-added `mcp_health_contract_ok` store-missing and handshake-failed branches are untested via the self-heal path; the only self-heal health-failure test drives the curl-fails branch. A restarted live backend that comes up curl-reachable but reports store expected-and-not-present, or handshake ok=false, would incorrectly be treated as recovered by `mcp_wait_health_contract` with no regression test to catch it.
scenarios: A dead live backend is restarted, the process listens and /health returns 200, but the container came up without its ticket store (store expected, not present) or with a failing MCP handshake
A regression that removes the store or handshake checks from mcp_health_contract_ok
dropped.suggested_fix: Duplicate test_dead_live_mcp_backend_health_failure_is_retryable twice, replacing the 'DOWN' seed with `{"in_flight":0,"store":{"present":false,"expected":true}}` and `{"in_flight":0,"handshake":{"ok":false}}` respectively, and assert result.returncode != 0 and mcp-deploy-backoff exists in each.
